examples.en: I am at the crossroads in my career.
examples.zh: 我的事業正處於重要關頭。

examples.en: The school is at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 學校正面臨重要抉擇。

meaning.en: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.
meaning.zh: 處於重要而未明朗的關頭，需要決定下一步應走哪個方向。
naturalZh: 處於重要而未明朗的關頭，需要決定下一步應走哪個方向。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; workplace discussions; presentations; interviews; news and commentary; general formal writing; personal reflection.
register.summaryZh: 固定部分 at the crossroads
register.formalEn: everyday conversation; workplace discussions; presentations; interviews; news and commentary; general formal writing; personal reflection.
register.formalZh: 簡報； 訪問； 新聞及評論； 一般正式寫作； 個人反思。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.example: I am at the crossroads in my career.

forms.form: Subject + may / might / could / will + be + at the crossroads.
forms.example: The project may be at the crossroads.

forms.form: Subject + seem(s) / appear(s) + to be + at the crossroads.
forms.example: Their relationship seems to be at the crossroads.

forms.form: Subject + stand(s) / remain(s) + at the crossroads.
forms.example: The hotel stands at the crossroads.

forms.form: Subject + find(s) / found + oneself + at the crossroads.
forms.example: The club finds itself at the crossroads.

forms.form: Cause + leave(s) / put(s) / place(s) + person or thing + at the crossroads.
forms.example: The sudden change left the team at the crossroads.

forms.form: At the crossroads, + subject + decision or action.
forms.example: At the crossroads, the owner must choose a new direction.

forms.form: With + subject + at the crossroads, + main clause.
forms.example: With the club at the crossroads, the members must vote.

forms.form: Subject + describe / view / regard + object + as being + at the crossroads.
forms.example: The report describes the industry as being at the crossroads.

specificForms.titleZh: 句式一：放在 be 後面
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is the most common and direct structure.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是最常見、最直接的結構。

examples.en: I am at the crossroads in my career.
examples.zh: 我的事業正處於重要關頭。

examples.en: The school is at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 學校正面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: They were at the crossroads after the plan failed.
examples.zh: 計劃失敗後，他們正處於關鍵時刻。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式二：放在情態動詞後面
specificForms.formula: Subject + may / might / could / will + be + at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The modal verb is part of the surrounding grammar, not part of the idiom.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 情態動詞屬於外圍文法，並不是慣用語的一部分。

examples.en: The project may be at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 項目可能正處於關鍵時刻。

examples.en: We could soon be at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 我們可能很快便要面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: The industry will be at the crossroads if demand continues to fall.
examples.zh: 如果需求繼續下降，這個行業將面臨重要抉擇。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式三：放在 seem 或 appear 後面
specificForms.formula: Subject + seem(s) / appear(s) + to be + at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern preserves uncertainty. It does not state the situation as a definite fact.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個結構保留不確定性，並非把情況說成確定事實。

examples.en: Their relationship seems to be at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 他們的關係似乎正處於重要關頭。

examples.en: The business appeared to be at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 公司當時似乎正面臨關鍵抉擇。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式四：放在 stand 或 remain 後面
specificForms.formula: Subject + stand(s) / remain(s) + at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Stand creates a vivid image of somebody or something facing different possible paths.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 帶出較鮮明的畫面，像某人或某事物正面對不同道路。

examples.en: The hotel stands at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 酒店正處於重要轉捩點。

examples.en: The town remained at the crossroads for several months.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮數月來一直處於抉擇關頭。

specificForms.formula: Subject + find(s) / found + oneself + at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionEn: I find myself; you find yourself; he finds himself; she finds herself; we find ourselves; they find themselves.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 反身代名詞必須與主語一致。

examples.en: The club finds itself at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 學會發現自己正面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: Clara found herself at the crossroads after receiving two job offers.
examples.zh: 收到兩份工作邀請後，發現自己正面臨重要抉擇。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式六：放在 leave、put 或 place 後面
specificForms.formula: Cause + leave(s) / put(s) / place(s) + person or thing + at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This structure explains what caused the difficult choice.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個結構說明甚麼事情導致當事人面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: The sudden change left the team at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 突如其來的改變令團隊面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: Rising costs have put the shop at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 成本上升令店舖面臨關鍵抉擇。

examples.en: The new rule placed many businesses at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 新規則令許多公司面臨重要抉擇。

specificForms.titleEn: At the Beginning of a Sentence
specificForms.formula: At the crossroads, + subject + decision or action.
specificForms.descriptionEn: A comma normally follows the opening expression.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句首表達後面通常使用逗號。

examples.en: At the crossroads, the owner must choose a new direction.
examples.zh: 處於關鍵時刻，店主必須選擇新的方向。

examples.en: At the crossroads in her career, Fiona must choose between two very different futures.
examples.zh: 事業正處於重要關頭，Fiona 必須在兩個截然不同的未來之間作出選擇。

specificForms.formula: With + subject + at the crossroads, + main clause.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This structure presents the critical situation as the background for a decision.
specificForms.descriptionZh: with + 主語 + at the crossroads 這個結構把關鍵情況作為主要決定的背景。

examples.en: With the club at the crossroads, the members must vote.
examples.zh: 學會正處於關鍵時刻，會員必須進行投票。

examples.en: With his career at the crossroads, Marcus returned to university.
examples.zh: Marcus 的事業正處於重要關頭，因此他重返大學。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式九：配合 being 的嵌入結構
specificForms.formula: Subject + describe / view / regard + object + as being + at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Being belongs to the surrounding grammar. The target expression remains at the crossroads.
specificForms.descriptionZh: being 屬於外圍文法。 目標表達仍然只是 at the crossroads。

examples.en: The report describes the industry as being at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 報告形容這個行業正處於重要轉捩點。

specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Be + subject + at the crossroads?.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Be + subject + at the crossroads?。

examples.en: Are we at the crossroads?
examples.zh: 我們是否正處於重要抉擇的關頭？

examples.en: Is the company really at the crossroads?
examples.zh: 公司是否真的正面臨重要抉擇？

examples.en: Why is the school at the crossroads?
examples.zh: 學校為甚麼正處於關鍵時刻？

benefits.titleEn: It Expresses an Important Turning Point
benefits.en: The idiom shows that a person or organisation has reached a stage where continuing without change is no longer easy.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語說明某人或某個組織已來到重要階段，難以毫無改變地繼續下去。 公司正處於重要抉擇的關頭。

examples.en: The company is at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 公司正處於重要抉擇的關頭。

benefits.titleEn: It Creates a Clear Mental Image
benefits.en: A traveller at a real crossroads must choose which road to follow. The idiom applies the same image to an important life or organisational decision.
benefits.zh: 旅人在真正的十字路口必須選擇道路。 這個慣用語把相同畫面應用於人生或組織的重要決定。

benefits.en: The expression works naturally before an explanation of two possible directions.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以自然地引出兩個可能方向。 學會正面臨維持小規模還是接納更多會員的重要抉擇。

examples.en: The club is at the crossroads between remaining small and accepting more members.
examples.zh: 學會正面臨維持小規模還是接納更多會員的重要抉擇。

benefits.titleEn: It Works for Both People and Organisations
benefits.titleZh: 同時適用於個人及組織
benefits.en: It Works for Both People and Organisations
benefits.zh: Fiona 的事業正處於重要關頭。 醫院正面臨有關未來的重要抉擇。

examples.en: Fiona is at the crossroads in her career.
examples.zh: Fiona 的事業正處於重要關頭。

examples.en: The hospital is at the crossroads over its future.
examples.zh: 醫院正面臨有關未來的重要抉擇。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Express Uncertainty Without Saying the
benefits.titleZh: 可以表達不確定，但不一定表示結果負面
benefits.en: The idiom does not predict failure. It simply highlights that the next decision matters.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語並不預言失敗，只是強調下一項決定十分重要。 她收到兩份優厚的邀請，因此正面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: She is at the crossroads because she has received two excellent offers.
examples.zh: 她收到兩份優厚的邀請，因此正面臨重要抉擇。

benefits.titleEn: It Provides Several Natural Grammar Shells
benefits.titleZh: 提供多種自然句法框架
benefits.en: This creates genuine sentence variety without changing the target expression.
benefits.zh: 這些句式在不改變目標表達的情況下，提供真正的句法變化。

origin.statusEn: Gradual Metaphorical Development; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成的比喻用法；確切首次用法不明

history.en: The English noun crossroad was recorded as a road term in the late seventeenth century. Historical word records trace the figurative meaning of a turning point or moment of decision to the eighteenth century. The exact first speaker and first idiomatic use cannot be identified confidently.
history.zh: 英語名詞 crossroad 在十七世紀後期已有道路相關記錄。 歷史詞源資料把「轉捩點」或「作決定的時刻」這個比喻意思追溯至十八世紀。 不過，我們無法有把握地確定第一位使用者或確切首次慣用語用例。

history.en: The development is straightforward. A person standing where several roads separate cannot continue without choosing a direction. Speakers gradually applied this physical situation to careers, relationships, businesses and public decisions.
history.zh: 意思演變十分直接。 站在數條道路分開之處的人，不能在不選擇方向的情況下繼續前進。 說話者後來逐漸把這個實際情況應用於事業、關係、公司及公共決定。

origin.memoryEn: Different roads lead to different destinations; different decisions lead to different futures.
origin.memoryZh: 不同道路通往不同目的地；不同決定帶來不同未來。

rules.titleEn: It Must Be an Important Decision
rules.titleZh: 規則一：必須涉及重要決定
rules.en: Choosing a drink is usually too minor to justify the idiom. A humorous speaker might deliberately exaggerate, but humorous exaggeration is not taught in this exercise.
rules.zh: 正面臨到外國工作還是留在家人身邊的重要抉擇。 正面臨點茶還是咖啡的抉擇。 選擇飲品通常太微不足道，不足以使用這個慣用語。 說話者有時可能故意誇張以製造幽默效果，但本練習不教授這種用法。

examples.en: Eric is at the crossroads between accepting a job abroad and staying near his family.
examples.zh: 正面臨到外國工作還是留在家人身邊的重要抉擇。

examples.en: Eric is at the crossroads between ordering tea and ordering coffee.
examples.zh: 正面臨點茶還是咖啡的抉擇。

rules.titleEn: More Than One Future Direction Must Be Possible
rules.titleZh: 規則二：未來必須有多於一個可能方向
rules.en: More Than One Future Direction Must Be Possible
rules.zh: 學校必須決定維修舊校舍還是搬往其他地方，正面臨重要抉擇。 學校已作出選擇，因此已不再處於抉擇關頭。

examples.en: The school is at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 學校必須決定維修舊校舍還是搬往其他地方，正面臨重要抉擇。

examples.en: The choice has already been made, so the school is no longer at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 學校已作出選擇，因此已不再處於抉擇關頭。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Merely for a Difficult Situation
rules.titleZh: 規則三：不要只因情況困難便使用
rules.en: The shop is losing money and must choose between closing and changing its business. The shop was very busy today. The second sentence contains no important choice about the future.
rules.zh: 店舖正在虧蝕，必須在結業和改變經營方式之間作出選擇。 店舖今天十分繁忙。 第二句並沒有涉及對未來的重要選擇。

rules.titleEn: The Expression Can Be Positive or Negative
rules.titleZh: 規則四：表達可以是正面或負面
rules.en: The idiom describes the importance of the choice, not whether every option is bad.
rules.zh: 公司失去最大顧客後，正處於令人擔憂的關鍵時刻。 收到兩份優厚的工作邀請後，正面臨重要抉擇。 這個慣用語描述選擇的重要性，而不是表示所有選項都不好。

examples.en: The company is at the crossroads after losing its biggest customer.
examples.zh: 公司失去最大顧客後，正處於令人擔憂的關鍵時刻。

examples.en: After receiving two excellent job offers, Clara finds herself at the crossroads.
examples.zh: 收到兩份優厚的工作邀請後，正面臨重要抉擇。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：at a crossroads 亦屬自然用法
rules.en: Therefore, every answer must use the. at the crossroads
rules.zh: 不過，本練習的指定目標是： 因此，所有答案都必須使用 the。

rules.titleEn: “Reach a Crossroads” Is Related but Not the
rules.en: Target She has reached a crossroads in her career.
rules.zh: reach a crossroads 意思相關但不是指定答案規則六：reach a crossroads 意思相關但不是指定答案 Natural English: 她的事業已來到重要關頭。 她的事業正處於重要關頭。

examples.en: She is at the crossroads in her career.
examples.zh: 她的事業正處於重要關頭。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with the Meeting of Two Fields
rules.titleZh: 規則七：不要與兩個領域的交匯混淆
rules.en: being at a point where an important direction must be chosen It does not teach the separate use in which crossroads simply describes where subjects, cultures or fields meet.
rules.zh: 本練習教授： 本練習不教授 crossroads 純粹表示學科、文化或領域交匯點的另一種用法。

rules.titleZh: 規則八：額外資料並不是固定部分
rules.en: The company is at the crossroads. What are the choices? Do not teach the whole sentence as though between A and B were compulsory.
rules.zh: 以下句子亦屬完整： between staying small and expanding 是可選延伸部分，用來回答： 不要把整個句子視為固定形式，令人誤以為 between A and B 是必須部分。

rules.titleZh: 規則九：保留時態及確定程度
rules.en: Do not change may be into is. That would turn a possibility into a fact.
rules.zh: 不要把 may be 改成 is，否則會把可能性變成確定事實。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：避免意外產生字面意思
rules.en: In this exercise, every answer must use the figurative decision-point meaning.
rules.zh: 我們在十字路口停下來查看地圖。 我們正處於關鍵時刻，必須決定項目的未來。 在本練習中，所有答案都必須使用「面臨重要抉擇」的比喻意思。

examples.en: We stopped at the crossroads and checked the map.
examples.zh: 我們在十字路口停下來查看地圖。

examples.en: We were at the crossroads and had to choose the future of the project.
examples.zh: 我們正處於關鍵時刻，必須決定項目的未來。

instructions.en: Every answer must contain the exact target expression.
instructions.zh: 使用 at the crossroads 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: I have to choose between becoming a teacher and working as a designer. This choice could shape my whole career.
questions.promptZh: 我必須在成為老師和從事設計工作之間作出選擇。這項選擇可能會影響我的整個事業。
questions.answer: I am at the crossroads in my career and must choose between teaching and design.
questions.answerZh: 我的事業正處於重要關頭，必須在教學和設計工作之間作出選擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: The family must make an important choice: move abroad or remain where it is.
questions.promptZh: 這個家庭必須作出重要選擇：移居外國還是留在原居地。
questions.answer: The family is at the crossroads over whether to move abroad or stay.
questions.answerZh: 這個家庭正面臨移居外國還是留下的重要抉擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: Our school has reached an important stage. It must choose between keeping examinations and using project work.
questions.promptZh: 我們的學校已來到重要階段，必須選擇保留考試還是採用專題習作。
questions.answer: Our school is at the crossroads between keeping exams and using project work.
questions.answerZh: 我們的學校正面臨保留考試還是採用專題習作的重要抉擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: Daniel must choose between accepting the job and continuing his studies. Either choice will change his future.
questions.promptZh: Daniel 必須選擇接受工作還是繼續學業。任何一個選擇都會改變他的未來。
questions.answer: Daniel stands at the crossroads between accepting the job and continuing his studies.
questions.answerZh: Daniel 正面臨接受工作還是繼續學業的重要抉擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: The café has lost money for six months and must now make a major decision about its future.
questions.promptZh: 咖啡店已虧蝕六個月，現在必須就未來作出重大決定。
questions.answer: After six months of losses, the café is at the crossroads.
questions.answerZh: 虧蝕六個月後，咖啡店正處於決定未來方向的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: We have reached the point where we must choose one of the two plans.
questions.promptZh: 我們已來到必須從兩個計劃中選擇一個的關頭。
questions.answer: We are at the crossroads and need to choose one of the two plans.
questions.answerZh: 我們正處於抉擇關頭，需要從兩個計劃中選擇一個。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: The record company has ended her contract, so the future of her music career now depends on an important choice.
questions.promptZh: 唱片公司已終止她的合約，因此她的音樂事業未來取決於一項重要選擇。
questions.answer: Her music career is at the crossroads after the record company ended her contract.
questions.answerZh: 唱片公司終止她的合約後，她的音樂事業正處於重要關頭。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: The club must now make an important decision about whether and how it should continue.
questions.promptZh: 學會現在必須就是否繼續及如何繼續作出重要決定。
questions.answer: The club now finds itself at the crossroads over its future.
questions.answerZh: 學會現在發現自己正面臨有關未來的重要抉擇。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: An unexpected result has forced the team into a situation where it must choose a new direction.
questions.promptZh: 一個意外結果令團隊陷入必須選擇新方向的情況。
questions.answer: This unexpected result has left the team at the crossroads.
questions.answerZh: 這個意外結果令團隊面臨決定未來方向的關鍵時刻。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.

questions.prompt: The shop owner must now choose between closing the business and beginning to sell online.
questions.promptZh: 店主現在必須選擇結業還是開始在網上銷售。
questions.answer: At the crossroads, the shop owner must decide whether to close or begin selling online.
questions.answerZh: 處於關鍵時刻，店主必須決定結業還是開始在網上銷售。
questions.targetMeaning: To be at an important and uncertain stage when a person, group, organisation or situation must choose which direction to take.
